title: Kingdom Rush: Rift in Time
subtitle: Cooperative Tower Defense & Polyomino Puzzle Campaign
tagline: Build towers, unleash heroic powers, and seal the mysterious Time Rift across 10 progressive scenarios.
loreSummary: The kingdom of Linirea is under assault by the enigmatic Time Mage and his ravenous hordes. Work together to pass polyomino attack tiles to upgrade defense towers, cast devastating spells, and coordinate hero champions to hold the paths before the enemy breaks through to the realm.
keyFeatures: Tabletop adaptation of the mega-hit mobile tower defense video game by Ironhide Studios
Clever cooperative polyomino puzzle combat: cover monster spawn trays with polyomino attack tiles
Dynamic tower upgrading system: pass tower cards to teammates between rounds to level them up
10 progressive campaign scenarios featuring unique boss mechanics, portals, and iron challenges

kingdom_rush_iron_challenge.description: An intense campaign run tackling all 10 core scenarios alongside heroic and iron challenge constraints.
